archetypes.name: Lumberjack Rush
archetypes.philosophy: Aggressively build Lumberjacks to clear trees and strike enemy Archons/Gardeners early.
key_changes: BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Prioritize building LUMBERJACK as soon as a Gardener is hired.
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Set shouldPlantTree to 0.1 to focus bullets on units.
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Set BULLET_RESERVE to 50 to allow early unit spam.
archetypes.engagement_style: Seek and destroy enemy Archons using Lumberjack strike.

archetypes.name: Scout Swarm
archetypes.philosophy: Swarm the enemy with Scouts to pick off Gardeners and disrupt economy.
key_changes: BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Prioritize building SCOUT for harassment.
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Increase shouldHireGardener probability to 1.0 if bullets > 100.
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Set getDonateAmount() to always return 0 until round 2000.
archetypes.engagement_style: Hit and run harassment of enemy Gardeners and Archons.

archetypes.name: Soldier Wall
archetypes.philosophy: Create a massive line of Soldiers to push across the map and overwhelm the enemy.
key_changes: BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Balanced build order: 1 Soldier for every 2 trees planted.
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Maintain BULLET_RESERVE at 150 for sustained production.
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Increase SOLDIER build weight in Gardener logic.
archetypes.engagement_style: Slow, methodical advance with a dense front line of Soldiers.

archetypes.name: VP Eco-Boom
archetypes.philosophy: Maximize tree production and donate everything to VP as early as possible.
key_changes: BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Set shouldPlantTree to 0.9.
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Reduce BULLET_RESERVE to 20 to maximize VP donation frequency.
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Only build units (Lumberjacks) if enemies are detected nearby.
archetypes.engagement_style: Avoid combat, focus entirely on tree health and bullet generation.

archetypes.name: Tank Fortress
archetypes.philosophy: Build a defensive perimeter of trees and eventually transition into high-power Tanks for the win.
key_changes: BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Increase BULLET_RESERVE to 350 to save up for Tanks.
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Prioritize TANK over all other units once reserve is met.
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Archon movement should be disabled to maintain base structure.
archetypes.engagement_style: Defensive until Tanks are online, then a crushing all-in push.

archetypes.name: The Gardener Swarm
archetypes.philosophy: Hire as many Gardeners as possible to spread across the map and plant trees everywhere.
key_changes: BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Archon should hire Gardeners as fast as cooldown allows (probability 1.0).
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Gardener movement should favor moving away from the Archon.
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Donate 100% of bullets above 100 to VP.
archetypes.engagement_style: Passive expansion and map saturation with trees.

archetypes.name: Aggressive Triad
archetypes.philosophy: Use Soldiers and Tanks focusing on Triad shots for maximum damage density.
key_changes: BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Prioritize SOLDIER and TANK production.
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Maintain BULLET_RESERVE at 200 to ensure enough bullets for Triad shots.
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): No tree planting allowed until 10 combat units are alive.
archetypes.engagement_style: Aggressive pursuit of enemy units, using Triad shots at close range.

archetypes.name: The Turtle
archetypes.philosophy: Stay extremely compact, build a thick wall of trees around Archons, and win via VP.
key_changes: BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Gardeners must plant trees in every available slot around the Archon.
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Only build Lumberjacks for defense if an enemy is within radius 5.
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): All excess bullets over 50 donated to VP immediately.
archetypes.engagement_style: Static defense, relying on tree walls to block enemy fire.

archetypes.name: Blitzkrieg
archetypes.philosophy: Fast movement and overwhelming numbers of cheap units (Soldiers/Lumberjacks) early on.
key_changes: BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Build 1st Gardener, then immediately build 5 Soldiers/Lumberjacks.
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): shouldHireGardener set to 1.0 until 3 Gardeners are out.
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Disable all tree planting for the first 500 rounds.
archetypes.engagement_style: Constant pressure and seeking out the enemy Archon location.

archetypes.name: Map Control Hybrid
archetypes.philosophy: Control neutral trees and map space with a mix of Lumberjacks and Soldiers, scaling into VP.
key_changes: BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Alternate between planting a tree and building a combat unit.
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Keep BULLET_RESERVE at 100 for versatility.
BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Donate 50% of excess bullets to VP, keep 50% for military expansion.
archetypes.engagement_style: Balanced approach, securing map resources while building a scoring engine.
